topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The space that was once mine, shaped by the walls and the familiar creaks, now whispers of change. The air carries the buzz of unfamiliar plans, the sight of new faces passing through what I thought was set. Shadows grow long where once they were known and safe. The news sticks in my throat, a hard lump that won’t shift. Walls that held my stories may soon hold others, their echoes different, their marks not mine. I circle my small corner, the edges of my world tightening, feeling the walls close in, each day a bit more foreign. The future looms, vast and undefined, the ground beneath my feet no longer steady.
